Technical SEO.title: Google Search Showing Fewer PDF Files. But Why?
Technical SEO.summary: Google appears to be indexing and surfacing fewer PDF files in search results, including from authoritative government domains like IRS.gov and New York State sites. In some cases PDFs still appear without explicit file-type filtering, suggesting a selective de-prioritization rather than a blanket exclusion.

Technical SEO.title: Google Says Google's Crawlers Don't Parse JSON
Technical SEO.summary: Google's Gary Illyes confirmed that Googlebot does not parse JSON files during crawling — it only downloads them, leaving parsing to the indexer. This has direct implications for sites relying on JSON-based data delivery or structured data implementations.

Technical SEO.title: Reports Indicate Google's Spam Update Focused On SEO AI Content
Technical SEO.summary: Community reports suggest Google's recent Spam Update may have specifically targeted mass-generated AI content used for SEO purposes. Enterprise publishers using scaled AI content production should audit affected properties for ranking changes.

Technical SEO.title: Google: There Is Nothing Special To Do For Generative AI Responses In Search
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller stated on Bluesky that there is nothing specifically required of site owners to appear in generative AI responses within Google Search. This official guidance is directly relevant to enterprise teams debating dedicated GEO tactics for AI Overviews.

Technical SEO.title: Google Shows AI Overviews Above Stock Charts For Stock Price Queries
Technical SEO.summary: Google is now displaying AI Overviews above stock chart widgets for stock price queries such as [GOOG stock] and [MSFT stock], a placement that appears to reduce result relevance. This signals continued expansion of AI Overview triggers into new query types, with potential implications for financial and data-driven content strategies.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Brings Developing-Topic Link Carousels To AI Mode
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has introduced developing-topic link carousels inside AI Mode, surfacing timely article links and Preferred Sources prominently within AI-generated responses. This creates a new editorial visibility opportunity for publishers producing timely content on evolving topics.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Why International SEO Needs Machine-Recognizable E-E-A-T
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that AI systems can flatten decades of localized expertise into a single generic brand impression, and that global brands must translate their credentials into evidence that machines can recognize and attribute. Directly relevant to enterprise travel and cruise brands operating across international markets.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Rebuilt Its Search Tool, I Read The New Language It Speaks
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An analysis of ChatGPT's rebuilt search tool reveals that 84 Reddit threads entered the retrieval pool but zero were cited, and the new tool-call format exposes what ChatGPT fetches before generating an answer. Understanding this retrieval logic is actionable for content teams optimizing for AI citation.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Your Promo Code Field May Be Sending Revenue To Affiliates
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An owned promo code landing page can retain purchase-ready shoppers who would otherwise exit to coupon affiliate sites, recovering revenue that leaks from ecommerce checkout flows. Relevant for enterprise travel and cruise brands with affiliate programs and high-intent checkout traffic.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering generative engine optimization in 2026: Full guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land has published a full guide to generative engine optimization practices for 2026, covering how to improve brand visibility in AI-generated search responses. As a practitioner-focused guide from a primary industry source, it is the highest-credibility GEO reference in this pool.

AI Search / GEO.title: More and more web indexing startups: Yandex search's ex-CEO started keenable
AI Search / GEO.summary: Accel-backed Keenable, founded by Yandex Search's former CEO, is building a web index specifically designed for AI agents, signaling a new wave of AI-native search infrastructure competing with Google's index. Enterprise SEO teams should monitor emerging agent-oriented indexes as potential new surfaces for content visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI | LLM Pulse
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse has published data on which domains are most frequently cited across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI responses. Benchmarking your domain's citation share against top-cited competitors is a core GEO measurement task for enterprise teams.
